title: 第47章 这是……丝袜？

第47章 这是……丝袜？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

上一章

存书签

下一章

一个新的标签出现在流浪商人旁边，图标是一只半闭的眼睛，眼瞳中倒映着迷雾。

许默点了进去。

黑市的界面和流浪商人完全不同，没有刷新按钮，而是满满当当一排商品栏，至少二十多个格子，每个格子里都躺着让人心跳加速的东西。

【晶化蛛丝（蓝色）】×10，售价3000幸存值。

这玩意，等老子晶化蜘蛛养成了，要多少有多少。

太特么黑了！

【血银矿（蓝色）】×5，售价450幸存值。

【灵泉精华（蓝色）】×1，售价200幸存值。

【魔能碎片（紫色）】×1，售价800幸存值。

【完整符文石板（紫色）】，售价1200幸存值。

一堆东西，都不知道干嘛用的。

接下来终于是重点了。

【胶原产物（蓝色）】×10，售价400幸运值。

【修复蛋白（蓝色）】×10，售价300幸运值。

这不就找到了吗？

白天要是有这个东西，也不至于搞得这么狼狈！

直到最后一个。

【再生药水配方（蓝色）】，售价600幸存值。

许默的目光在【再生药水配方】上停住了。

【再生药水（蓝色）】

【效果：饮用后在30秒内恢复30点生命值，不受战斗状态影响。】

【制造需求：糖×1，盐×1，宁神花粉×3，血蜜×10。】

六百幸存值，恢复类药品，恢复能力，一秒一点血！

关键是，材料真的好凑啊！

他深吸一口气。

立刻买下【再生药水配方】，羊皮卷轴化作知识涌入脑海。

买了一圈下来。

幸存值仅剩八百！

许默关掉黑市界面，靠在石壁上长长吐出一口浊气。

一晚上花出去将近五千幸存值，心疼得滴血。

不过，这黑市真不是一般人能玩得起的。

光刷新消耗的入场门槛就足足几百点幸存值！

重头戏，就是战斧图纸。

望远镜、新胸甲、丝袜、再生药水配方、蛛丝、灵泉精华……这些东西加在一起，足够让他在接下来一周的实力翻几倍。

方芸已经睡着了，呼吸均匀。

老枪在墙角打着轻微的鼾声。

A new label appeared next to the wandering businessman. The icon was a half-closed eye, with fog reflected in the pupils.

Xu Mo clicked in.

The interface of the black market is completely different from that of the wandering merchant. There is no refresh button, but a row of product columns with at least more than twenty grids, and each grid is filled with things that make people's hearts beat faster.

[Crystalized Spider Silk (Blue)] × 10, priced at 3000 survival points.

This thing, when I develop the crystallized spider, I can have as many as I want.

It’s so dark!

[Bloodsilver Ore (Blue)]×5, priced at 450 survival points.

[Lingquan Essence (Blue)] × 1, priced at 200 survival points.

[Magic Fragment (Purple)] × 1, priced at 800 survival points.

[Complete Rune Slate (Purple)], priced at 1,200 survival points.

There are a bunch of things that I don’t know what they are used for.

Next is finally the point.

[Collagen Product (Blue)] × 10, priced at 400 lucky points.

[Repair Protein (Blue)] × 10, priced at 300 lucky points.

Isn’t this what you found?

If we had this thing during the day, we wouldn't be in such a mess!

Until the last one.

[Regeneration Potion Recipe (Blue)], priced at 600 survival points.

Xu Mo's eyes stopped on the [Regeneration Potion Formula].

[Regeneration Potion (Blue)]

[Effect: After drinking, 30 points of health will be restored within 30 seconds, and will not be affected by combat status.】

[Manufacturing requirements: Sugar × 1, Salt × 1, Ningshen Pollen × 3, Blood Honey × 10.】

Six hundred survival points, recovery drugs, recovery ability, and one blood per second!

The key is, the materials are really easy to come together!

He took a deep breath.

I immediately bought the [Regeneration Potion Formula], and the parchment scroll turned into knowledge and poured into my mind.

I bought a lot.

There are only 800 survival points left!

Xu Mo closed the black market interface, leaned against the stone wall and let out a long breath.

I spent nearly 5,000 survival points in one night, and my heart was bleeding.

However, this black market is really not something that ordinary people can afford.

The entry threshold consumed by refreshing alone is hundreds of survival points!

The highlight is the battle ax drawing.

Telescope, new breastplate, stockings, regeneration potion formula, spider silk, spiritual spring essence... these things together are enough to increase his strength several times in the next week.

Fang Yun was already asleep, breathing evenly.

Lao Qiang snored slightly in the corner.
